assertions.title: Quick Actions navigate to correct panels and keep the target panel in the viewport

steps.action: Open /janus?view=all and capture the quick-action shell
steps.expected: All 7 quick-action buttons are available from the dashboard shell
steps.observed: The shell rendered Create Project, Import Repo, Upload Bundle, Review Builds, Create Deployment, Open Endpoint, and API Routes in the quick-actions region.

steps.action: Re-open /janus?view=all before each quick action, click the action, and measure the target panel bounding box
steps.expected: Each action switches to the correct workspace view and keeps its target panel fully within the 1280x800 viewport
steps.observed: Create Project -> /janus?view=projects with new-project-panel top 268 / bottom 686; Import Repo -> /janus?view=pipeline with repo-import-panel top 0 / bottom 286; Upload Bundle -> /janus?view=pipeline with artifact-uploads-panel top 0 / bottom 580; Review Builds -> /janus?view=pipeline with builds-panel top 0 / bottom 215; Create Deployment -> /janus?view=pipeline with deployments-panel top 0 / bottom 594; Open Endpoint -> /janus?view=pipeline with domains-panel top 585 / bottom 800; API Routes -> /janus?view=reference with api-panel top 332 / bottom 800. All target panels remained within the viewport.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed; agent-browser errors was cleared before the sequence and remained empty after all seven quick-action checks
evidence.network: agent-browser network requests --filter api reported no requests captured; the quick actions were verified as client-side view/scroll transitions to /janus?view=projects, /janus?view=pipeline, and /janus?view=reference.

assertions.title: Billing page renders with proper preview states

steps.expected: A billing loading state is visible while data is being fetched
steps.observed: The page rendered 'Loading Billing Data' with the supporting message 'Fetching your invoices and usage information from Stripe…'.

steps.expected: An empty billing state explains that no invoices exist yet
steps.observed: The page rendered 'No Invoices Yet' with copy explaining that invoices and usage records will appear after deployments start consuming resources.

steps.expected: A user-friendly billing error state is displayed
steps.observed: The page rendered 'Failed to Load Billing Data' with retry guidance and a visible Retry button.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed while validating the billing preview routes; agent-browser errors remained empty after the loading, empty, and error states
evidence.network: agent-browser network requests --filter api reported no requests captured during these preview checks; the loading, empty, and error billing states were driven by the preview query parameter.

assertions.title: Monitoring page renders with proper preview states

steps.expected: A monitoring loading state is visible while metrics are being fetched
steps.observed: The page rendered 'Loading Monitoring Data' with the supporting message 'Fetching deployment metrics and resource usage data…'.

steps.expected: An empty monitoring state explains that no metrics have been collected yet
steps.observed: The page rendered 'No Metrics Available' with copy explaining that CPU, RAM, disk, and network metrics will appear after a service is deployed.

steps.expected: A user-friendly monitoring error state is displayed
steps.observed: The page rendered 'Failed to Load Monitoring Data' with retry guidance and a visible Retry button.

evidence.consoleErrors: none observed while validating the monitoring preview routes; agent-browser errors remained empty after the loading, empty, and error states
evidence.network: agent-browser network requests --filter api reported no requests captured during these preview checks; the loading, empty, and error monitoring states were driven by the preview query parameter.

frictions.description: Two quick-action targets landed exactly on the bottom viewport boundary (domains-panel bottom 800 and api-panel bottom 800), making the screenshots alone slightly ambiguous.
